notes: The list, together with the queued IMSLP items, appears to cover Cui's original violin output: Opp. 14, 24, 25, 39, 50, 51 and 84, plus the separate Tarantella and Valse mélancolique. I could not confidently name any further original works or established violinist arrangements beyond the already-listed Orientale, so nothing is added rather than risk inventing titles. Works involving flute (e.g., the Op. 56 pieces for flute, violin and piano) were excluded as out of scope.
